## Performance evidence

- [ ] No performance claim is made.
- [ ] A schema-valid experiment and raw artifacts are attached.

For a performance claim, record baseline/candidate commits, clean-tree status, manifests, workload, all samples, statistics, profiler evidence and conclusion scope.

## Research integrity

- [ ] Primary sources and immutable revisions are recorded.
- [ ] External benchmark claims remain `external_unreproduced` unless reproduced here.
- [ ] Fact, inference, hypothesis, decision and measurement are distinguished.

## Security, supply chain and licensing

- [ ] No credentials, private data, machine UUIDs or model access tokens are included.
- [ ] New dependencies have license and security review.
- [ ] CI actions remain pinned to full commit SHAs.
- [ ] Self-hosted/GPU execution is not reachable from untrusted fork code.

## Project continuity

- [ ] ADRs updated when architecture changed.
- [ ] `CURRENT_STATE.md`, decisions, risks, questions and handoff updated when affected.
- [ ] `make ci` passes.

## Reviewer evidence

Reviewer, independently state what you inspected, what you executed, residual risks and whether every acceptance criterion is met.
